name: codeSplitter
line: A code host for agents: every file a Durable Object, agents editing line by line at once, real git on Cloudflare Artifacts.

name: git-recon
line: A toy-soldier shooter fought in a codebase: the repo is the level, its files the buildings, up to 64 to a battle.

name: Two Fronts
line: Thunder Marines against the Wooka horde: a turn-based war, then three.js battles on six worlds and in orbit. AI, hotseat or a friend online.

name: Park Hide & Seek
line: 3D hide and seek in all 63 national parks, from Half Dome to Old Faithful; each player is sent only what they can see. Headed to the App Store first.

name: Skate Tech Park
line: A giant riderless fingerboard on park terrain: vert, grinds and rails, or the rocket roadster skin whose jets fire with every trick.

name: Alien Disc Golf
line: Nine holes between countries on a 3D globe, the disc carried by NOAA's real wind right now; loft it into the jet stream if you dare.

name: Druids Curse
line: The live multiplayer game Rusty Buns was first built for.

name: Splat Spray
line: A spy game in the dark: scan a Gaussian-splat room, run the missions in your dossier and find 100 things in the fewest shots.

name: Excalibrawl
line: An hourly drawing fight between two models, refereed by a third.

name: Hippo Tycoon
line: Four greedy oil-baron hippos race to chomp the most oil from a jungle geyser; solo, couch, LAN or online, on whatever you have.

name: Mythic Masters
line: A 3D arena brawler of 76 folklore beasts where mass and height are real, from a 6 kg jackalope to a tonne of lake monster.

name: Delayed Reaction
line: A phone-first dub rhythm game: a ring calls a note down a neon tunnel and you answer it a bar later.

name: Auto Rig
line: The IK engine: drop in a 3D model, get a skeleton, skin weights and inverse kinematics you can drag around, in Rust and TypeScript.

name: tscircuit Desktop
line: tscircuit's circuit editor as one desktop file, with a Rust engine up to 22x faster. It works; parked until tscircuit updates its own dependencies.

name: FM Groovebox
line: A twelve-track FM groovebox with a drum machine, step sequencer, piano roll and reverb.

name: Hello World
line: The smallest Rusty Buns app: one page, static assets only.
